sections.title: Definisi dan Patofisiologi Infark Serebri

content.text: Cerebral infarction results from circulatory deficit due to thrombosis or cerebral embolism, manifesting as stroke. Predisposing factors include hypertension, diabetes mellitus, family history, and various conditions causing embolic or atherosclerotic disease. Symptoms may present as TIA (transient ischemic attack) with focal neurological deficits recovering within 24 hours, or as stroke with persistent neurological deficit.
Faktor predisposisi: Hipertensi, DM, riwayat keluarga
Gejala: TIA (defisit neurologis fokal recovery dalam 24 jam) atau Stroke (defisit persisten)
Pemeriksaan radiologi: CT, MRI, Carotid artery imaging (MRA/Doppler US), Arteriografi

sections.title: Gambaran Radiologi Infark

content.text: CT FINDINGS: CT may be normal in very early infarction and typically becomes clearly apparent after 24 hours. Early signs include loss of gray-white matter differentiation in the affected area and hypodense lesions in the vascular territory involved. HYPERDENSE MCA SIGN: On non-contrast CT, a hyperdense middle cerebral artery indicates acute thrombus within the vessel, an important early sign of large vessel occlusion. MRI-MRA: Demonstrates the occluded vascular region with greater sensitivity than CT, particularly in early infarction. Diffusion-weighted imaging (DWI) shows restricted diffusion within minutes of ischemia onset.
CT: dapat normal pada infark sangat awal, baru jelas setelah 24 jam
Lesi hipodens pada area yang terkena
Hyperdense MCA sign: tanda thrombus akut di arteri
MRI-MRA: menunjukkan regio teroklusi dengan sensitivitas lebih tinggi
Hyperdense MCA sign on non-contrast CT is a critical early finding indicating large vessel occlusion and potential candidate for thrombectomy

sections.title: Stroke Hemoragik

content.text: Hemorrhagic stroke appears on CT as hyperdense lesions. MRI shows hyperintense lesions with perilesional edema on T2-weighted images. GRE (Gradient Echo) sequences demonstrate hypointense lesions with surrounding edema, sensitive for blood products.
MRI T2: lesi hiperintens dengan edema peri-lesi
GRE: lesi hipointens dengan edema disekitarnya
GRE is sensitive for hemorrhage detection; hypointense signal indicates hemosiderin/ferritin
